llm_response.reason: The website impersonates the legitimate Roxy brand to target shoppers (characteristic 16: mimics legitimate brand). WHOIS data shows it is registered to an individual in China, not the official company or its European offices, indicating a non-existent or false affiliation (characteristic 4). The wide range of discounted products and free shipping/returns are common tactics to lure customers (characteristics 1 and 3). There is a lack of verifiable company/contact information (characteristics 4 and 6), and overall site behavior matches known fake branded shop scams.
